# Shark Exterior Cleaning

> Shark Exterior Cleaning (also called Shark Exterior) is a locally owned exterior cleaning company based in Lincoln, Nebraska, that also serves Kearney, Nebraska and nearby towns. It offers exterior and interior window cleaning, house soft washing, power washing, gutter cleaning, solar panel cleaning, window screen and track cleaning, holiday light installation, and commercial window cleaning for homes and businesses. Quotes are free, and it is rated 5.0 on Google.

- Social: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61573298251243 · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/sharkexterior/ · TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/@sharkexterior

## Why customers choose Shark Exterior

- Shark RainBlock: a hydrophobic coating applied after window cleaning so rain beads and rolls off, keeping glass cleaner longer between visits.
- 7-Day Rain Guarantee: if rain spots your windows within 7 days of a cleaning, Shark Exterior comes back and re-cleans them at no charge (included with Monthly and Quarterly memberships).
- 100% satisfaction guarantee: report any issue within 48 hours of service and the crew returns to make it right at no charge.
- Soft washing uses low pressure and biodegradable solutions that kill mold, algae and lichen at the root, which is safe for shingles, vinyl, painted wood and stucco.
- Before-and-after photos are sent after service. Customers do not need to be home for exterior-only work.
- One crew for many services: bundle services on the same visit to save on the whole visit.

## Pricing and savings

- Every property is priced with a free, no-obligation quote.
- Memberships: Monthly ($150 off every cleaning, 12 cleanings a year), Quarterly ($100 off every cleaning, 4 a year, most popular), Bi-Annual ($50 off every cleaning, 2 a year). Monthly and Quarterly include free Shark RainBlock, the 7-Day Rain Guarantee and hard water removal.
- Bundle discounts on the same visit: 10% off for 2 services, 15% off for 3, 20% off for 4 or more.
- Custom pricing for commercial properties.

## Services

- [Exterior Window Cleaning](https://sharkexteriorcleaning.com/service-exterior): streak-free exterior glass, frames and sills, with Shark RainBlock.
- [Interior Window Cleaning](https://sharkexteriorcleaning.com/service-interior): spotless inside glass, cleaned with care.
- [House Soft Washing](https://sharkexteriorcleaning.com/service-softwash): low-pressure washing for siding and roofs that removes mold, algae and stains.
- [Power Washing](https://sharkexteriorcleaning.com/service-powerwash): driveways, patios, sidewalks, steps and other concrete and brick.
- [Gutter Cleaning](https://sharkexteriorcleaning.com/service-gutter): hand-cleared gutters and flushed downspouts, with before and after photos.
- [Solar Panel Cleaning](https://sharkexteriorcleaning.com/service-solar): soft brushes and purified water to restore panel output safely.
- [Window Screen Cleaning](https://sharkexteriorcleaning.com/service-screen): screens removed, washed and reinstalled (often added to a window cleaning).
- [Window Track Detailing](https://sharkexteriorcleaning.com/service-track): tracks, sills and frames deep-cleaned.
- [Holiday Light Installation](https://sharkexteriorcleaning.com/service-christmas): custom design, professional LED lights, damage-free install, takedown and storage.
- [Commercial Window Cleaning](https://sharkexteriorcleaning.com/service-commercial): storefronts, offices and multi-story buildings on flexible recurring schedules.
